evidence.reason: `prior_tag_for()` enumerates every annotated `crq-runner/*` tag that peels to the given SHA and returns it without checking the tag name against the approval-tag pattern. Thus a non-approval annotated tag such as `crq-runner/staging` can be selected and written as `prior_tag`, contrary to the journal contract that this field is the prior target's annotated approval tag. This is an implementation defect in existing intended behavior; filtering candidates with the existing tag regex before appending is the smallest compatible fix.
